ModMetaData.name: Imperial Knights of the Rim
ModMetaData.author: ToxicBuckle565
ModMetaData.description:
Pilot towering Imperial Knights across the Rim.
Five Knight classes, each with its own weapons, armour and hangar: - Armiger - the fast, light hunter of the household - Questoris - the classic battle-ready Knight with the widest weapon choice - Cerastus - the swift Knight-Lancer, Acheron, Castigator and Atrapos patterns - Dominus - the heavy Castellan and Valiant with shoulder and carapace guns - Acastus Porphyrion - the super-heavy, with twin magna lascannons or twin conversion beams
FEATURES - Piloted walkers built on Vehicle Framework: a colonist climbs into the Throne Mechanicum and walks it to war - Research the Mechanicum path and build each Knight piece by piece at a forge - Knight hangar: dock, refit, repair and rearm; change every weapon mount from the hangar cogitator - Paint your house: two-colour schemes per Knight plus heraldic stickers (shields, beasts, crosses, banners and more) - Weapons that behave like the books: shock lances, conversion beams that hit harder the farther the target, graviton guns, Ironstorm and Helios missiles that can even swat drop pods out of the sky - Reactor meltdowns: a dying Knight may go up like a small sun - or its pilot can overload the plasma core in a Noble Sacrifice - Real recorded weapon and stomp sounds, weapon glow and muzzle light (adjustable in the mod settings)
OPTIONAL - Odyssey: Imperial plasma reactor for your gravship, and orbital drops - Knights fall from a gravship hangar onto the map below - Combat Extended: ammo and ballistics patches included
REQUIRES - Harmony - Vehicle Framework (Steam subscribes you to both automatically.)
CREDITS - Art: painted by ToxicBuckle565, based on community 3D models. Questoris parts from "Questoris Knight Builder" by Pedjorsi (Thingiverse, CC BY-NC-SA) - so this mod's art is shared under CC BY-NC-SA too. Some art is based on community models from various, partly unknown sources; if your work is used here and you would like credit or removal, please get in touch and it will be fixed quickly. - Sounds: freesound.org recordings, CC0 (list in About/SOUND_CREDITS.txt).
